Questions or a tour?

020 – 423 39 30 info@huizefrankendael.nl

The restaurant is open daily for coffee & cake, à la carte lunch and drinks; please book lunch online (opens in a new tab). We do not serve dinner, but a private dinner (from 15 people) in one of the rooms is possible — request information by email.

For meeting rooms and other group enquiries, preferably email info@huizefrankendael.nl, or call +31 20 423 39 30 (Mon–Fri 9 AM–5 PM).

From May through September we host many weddings during the weekends; lunch hours are often adjusted on those days. The online reservation system will indicate this automatically.

Reservations at restaurant Merkelbach

Book coffee, lunch or drinks online at Merkelbach (opens in a new tab). Please note: the restaurant only accepts debit or credit cards.

Wedding photography

As we host groups in the house daily, stand-alone bridal photography is unfortunately not possible — unless you are getting married with us, in which case it naturally is.
